items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags
Dismantle the coupling between pump and motor
Check alignment.
Dismantle the motor bolt's with base.
Dismantle the pump casing from diffuser
Dismantle the bolts from pump casing with base
Take the pump out.
Check clearance between impeller and diffuser.
Dismantle the impeller nuts and remove the impeller
Remove all parts of mechanical seal
Remove the shaft with bearings from pump casing
Remove the ball bearings and gland sleeve.
Inspect the ball bearing and shaft sleeve change it if it is needed
Inspect the shaft runout must not exceed 0.03 mm
Inspect the clearance between impeller and suction wear ring
Inspect the face of mechanical seal parts
All parts must be carefully cleaned
Reassemble bearings in the shaft and shaft sleeve
Reassemble the shaft with bearings to the pump casing
Reassemble the mech. Seal Parts
Reassemble the impeller and tight the imp. Nut
Reassemble the pump casing with diffuser

Reassemble the auxiliary pipes (suction, delivery) and tight the bolts for 
 pump casing with base
Check the alignment between pump and motor.

Check isolating valves ( suction, 
 delivery ) open
Check the direction of rotation
Check pressure.
Check vibration.
Check for abnormal noise
Check the temperature of bearings
Check mechanical seal leakage.
